assessment.body:
Day 46 ends with cautious optimism tempered by serious new escalation risks.

THE DIPLOMATIC SIGNAL
• US officials confirming details for potential SECOND in-person meeting with Iran
• Two sides still communicating (CNN US official confirmed)
• Pakistan offering to host next round in Islamabad again
• Brent crude fell to ~$98.6 — markets pricing in renewed diplomacy
• BUT: Iran has not formally confirmed Trump's 'right people called me' claim
• Iranian team in Pakistan lacked authorization to 'cut a deal' — Vance
• Core sticking points: nuclear enrichment, $270B reparations, Hormuz control, Lebanon

BLOCKADE DAY 2 — DUAL CONSTRAINT
• 3 ships transited Hormuz today — BOTH were US-sanctioned vessels
• Rich Starry (China/US-sanctioned) passed through; Elpis (Iranian oil) nearly stopped in Gulf of Oman
• Commercial vessels now face impossible compliance: need BOTH US + Iran clearance simultaneously
• Al Jazeera: 'Real risk of escalation if Iranian vessels are stopped'
• Iran's Mohsen Rezaee: US 'doomed to fail in any naval blockade' — Iran has 'untapped capabilities'

CHINA WILDCARD
• US intelligence: China planning to provide new air-defense weapons to Iran 'in coming weeks'
• If confirmed: dramatically changes military calculus — Iran air-defense restoration makes strike resumption far more costly
• Trump warned China will face 'big problems' if confirmed
• China denied: 'never provided weapons to any party to the conflict'
• This is potentially the most significant escalation factor since blockade began

INDIA MARKET OUTLOOK (Wed Apr 15 Reopen)
• Sensex Apr 13 close: 76,847 (-702 / -0.91%)
• GIFT Nifty ~23,877 (-0.59%) — cautious reopen expected
• Brent ~$98.6 — below $100 = modest positive for India
• FII sold ₹1,244 Cr Mon; DII bought ₹2,051 Cr
• If second-round talks confirmed by Wed open: Sensex could gap up 500-800 pts
• If China air-defense confirmed or Iran incident occurs: Sensex could gap down sharply
• India has 85%+ Hormuz crude dependency + 6-8 weeks fuel buffer — dual blockade shortening this window

KEY DATE: APR 22 — CEASEFIRE EXPIRY
• 8 days remain. This is the event horizon.
• If second round talks happen before Apr 22: ceasefire likely extended, Brent could collapse to $80-85
• If no deal by Apr 22: ceasefire lapses — Iran maximum combat alert + Trump 'locked and loaded' = extreme escalation
• If China delivers air-defense before Apr 22: changes entire military equation

VERDICT: Cautiously optimistic but fragile. Second-round talks signal is genuinely positive — the first real diplomatic momentum since Islamabad collapsed. But China air-defense intelligence, Iran's $270B reparations demand, Hezbollah rejecting Lebanon talks, and dual blockade compliance impossibility mean Apr 22 remains a genuine crisis point. Watch for: formal Iran response to Trump's contact claim, any Chinese arms delivery confirmation, first incident under dual blockade.
